about_short_description.short_description: SalaryBook is a mobile app helping MSMEs in planning the employee management and finance in an organized manner.

product.name: Attendance Management
product.description: A tool to record employee attendance with one click and calculate salaries based on attendance, including overtime, late fines, leaves, and half days.

product.name: Payroll Management
product.description: A system to maintain records of salaries, advances, allowances, bonuses, and deductions, and to facilitate salary payments to employees.

product.name: Expense Management
product.description: A feature to record and manage business expenses in one place, simplifying expense tracking and month-end calculations.

product.name: Salary (Early Salary)
product.description: A service allowing employees to access a portion of their salary before payday, which is automatically deducted from their next paycheck without fees or interest.

product.name: Hire Employees
product.description: A platform to post job requirements, find suitable candidates, and manage hiring and onboarding processes including offer letters and onboarding checklists.

product.name: Job Search Portal
product.description: A free job search platform for blue and grey collar workers to find jobs based on profile, location, salary, and job type filters.
